title: A unit orientation of the line ℝe (‖e‖ = 1) is ±(α ↦ α(e)) (parent step 5)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let e ∈ ℝ^P with ‖e‖ = 1, and let ξ ∈ Λ_1(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P 1, the continuous linear functionals on 1-covectors) satisfy IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (span{e}). That is, there is an orthonormal τ : Fin 1 → ℝ^P with span(range τ) = span{e} such that either ξ(α) = α(τ) for all 1-covectors α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ) for all α. Then ξ = ev_e or ξ = −ev_e, where ev_e = ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => e) is the 1-vector α ↦ α(fun _ => e).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (e : Euclid P) (ξ : MultiVector P 1), ‖e‖ = 1 → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (Submodule.span ℝ {e}) → ξ = ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => e) ∨ ξ = -ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => e)
